meta: Ask AI to research and write a sourced report: agent reports look very professional, but don't trust any sentence without a source.

muc.title: Polished but unsourced
muc.text: A report written by an agent looks very professional, but any sentence without a source shouldn't be trusted yet.

muc.title: Narrow the topic
muc.text: First, narrow the topic, for example the cost of charging an electric scooter at home for one month.

muc.title: A source after every point
muc.text: Tell the agent to put a source after every point, prefer official sites, and say clearly which points have no source.

muc.title: Open three sources
muc.text: When you're done reading, open three sources and see if each page says what the report claims. One error means re-checking the whole thing.

muc.title: Five points with sources
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to research a small topic, request five points with sources, then open and check two of them.
